const fm = FileManager.local();
const statePath = fm.joinPath(fm.libraryDirectory(), 'nerv_command_v2_state.json');
const backupPath = fm.joinPath(fm.libraryDirectory(), 'nerv_command_v2_state_pre_v2_7_backup.json');
try { if (fm.fileExists(statePath) && !fm.fileExists(backupPath)) fm.copy(statePath, backupPath); } catch (e) { console.warn('State backup failed: '+e); }
const lastGoodPath=fm.joinPath(fm.libraryDirectory(),'nerv_command_v2_state_last_good.json');
const worldBackupPath=fm.joinPath(fm.libraryDirectory(),'nerv_command_v2_state_before_world.json');
let storedState=null,stateRecovery=null;
function nativeValidState(raw){try{const value=JSON.parse(raw);return value&&typeof value==='object'&&!Array.isArray(value)?value:null;}catch(error){return null;}}
try{
 if(fm.fileExists(statePath)){
  const raw=fm.readString(statePath);storedState=nativeValidState(raw);
  if(!storedState){
   let quarantine=fm.joinPath(fm.libraryDirectory(),'nerv_command_corrupt_'+Date.now()+'.txt'),i=0;while(fm.fileExists(quarantine))quarantine=fm.joinPath(fm.libraryDirectory(),'nerv_command_corrupt_'+Date.now()+'_'+(++i)+'.txt');
   try{
    fm.copy(statePath,quarantine);
    if(fm.fileExists(lastGoodPath))storedState=nativeValidState(fm.readString(lastGoodPath));
    stateRecovery={recovered:true,blocked:false,source:storedState?'last-good':'defaults',message:storedState?'破損データを別保存し、直前の正常保存から復旧しました。':'破損データを別保存しました。正常な控えがないため初期状態で開いています。'};
   }catch(error){stateRecovery={blocked:true,message:'破損データを退避できないため、元の保存ファイルへの書込みを停止しています。'};}
  }
 }
}catch(error){stateRecovery={blocked:true,message:'保存ファイルを読み取れないため、書込みを停止しています。'};}
function getBatteryInfo() {
  try { return {level:Math.round(Device.batteryLevel()*100),charging:Device.isCharging()}; }
  catch(e){return {level:null,charging:false};}
}

  function aiNativeConfig(){
    try{const c=Keychain.contains(aiConfigName)?JSON.parse(Keychain.get(aiConfigName)):{};return {schema:1,endpoint:typeof c.endpoint==='string'?c.endpoint:'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses',model:typeof c.model==='string'?c.model:'gpt-4.1-mini',enabled:c.enabled===true};}catch(e){return {schema:1,endpoint:'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses',model:'gpt-4.1-mini',enabled:false};}
  }
  function aiNativeEndpoint(value){
    const m=String(value||'').match(/^https:\/\/([a-z0-9.-]+)(?::443)?(\/[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+)$/i);
    if(!m||!m[1].includes('.')||/^\d[\d.]*$/.test(m[1])||/(^|\.)(localhost|local|internal)$/.test(m[1])||m[2].includes('..')||!/(\/responses|\/chat\/completions)$/.test(m[2]))throw Error('endpoint');
    return {url:'https://'+m[1].toLowerCase()+m[2],host:m[1].toLowerCase(),provider:m[2].endsWith('/responses')?'responses':'chat'};
  }
  function aiNativeStatus(){
    const c=aiNativeConfig();let ep;try{ep=aiNativeEndpoint(c.endpoint);}catch(e){ep={host:'未設定',provider:'responses'};}
    return {available:true,configured:Keychain.contains(aiKeyName),enabled:c.enabled&&Keychain.contains(aiKeyName),model:c.model,endpoint:c.endpoint,host:ep.host,provider:ep.provider,generation:aiNativeGeneration};
  }
  function aiNativeStore(c,key){

    try{if(key)Keychain.set(aiKeyName,key);Keychain.set(aiConfigName,JSON.stringify(c));aiNativeGeneration++;aiNativeCache.clear();}
    catch(e){try{if(previousKey!==null)Keychain.set(aiKeyName,previousKey);else if(Keychain.contains(aiKeyName))Keychain.remove(aiKeyName);if(previousConfig!==null)Keychain.set(aiConfigName,previousConfig);else if(Keychain.contains(aiConfigName))Keychain.remove(aiConfigName);}catch(ignored){}throw Error('secure-storage');}
  }

  function aiNativeValidate(raw){
    const allowed=['duty-review','analysis-review','incident-review','tactical-review'];
    if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw)||typeof raw.text!=='string'||!raw.text.trim()||raw.text.length>320||Object.keys(raw).some(k=>!['text','suggestion'].includes(k))||raw.suggestion!=null&&!allowed.includes(raw.suggestion))throw Error('invalid-reply');

  }
  async function aiNativeReply(payload){
    if(!shown)return {error:'画面を終了しました'};

      const user=JSON.stringify({context,input:payload.input});

  async function weatherFromCurrentLocation(){
    Location.setAccuracyToHundredMeters();
    const loc=await Location.current();
    const lat=loc.latitude,lon=loc.longitude;
    if (!Number.isFinite(lat)||!Number.isFinite(lon)) throw new Error('有効な位置情報が取得できません');
    const api='https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude='+encodeURIComponent(lat)+'&longitude='+encodeURIComponent(lon)+'&current=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,apparent_temperature,precipitation,weather_code,pressure_msl,wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m&hourly=temperature_2m,precipitation_probability,weather_code&forecast_days=2&timezone=auto';
    const r=new Request(api);r.timeoutInterval=18;
    const data=await r.loadJSON();
    if(!data?.current || !data?.hourly)throw new Error('気象APIから有効なデータを取得できません');
    let place='現在地';
    try{const geos=await Location.reverseGeocode(lat,lon,'ja-JP');if(geos?.length){const g=geos[0];place=g.locality||g.subLocality||g.administrativeArea||'現在地';}}catch(e){}
    return {weather:data,place,position:{lat,lon},updated:Date.now()};
  }
  async function handle(job){
    if(job.action==='aiStatus')return aiNativeStatus();
    if(job.action==='aiConfigure')return await aiNativeConfigure();
    if(job.action==='clipboard'){Pasteboard.copyString(String(job.payload?.text||''));return {ok:true};}
    if(job.action==='backupWorld'){
      const snapshot=JSON.stringify(job.payload?.state||{});if(snapshot.length>200000)return {error:'当直バックアップ容量を超過しました'};
      const base=worldBackupPath+(job.payload?.extension==='v212-messages'?'.v212-messages':'');let path=base;
      if(job.payload?.quarantine){path=base+'.repair-'+Date.now();let i=0;while(fm.fileExists(path))path=base+'.repair-'+Date.now()+'-'+(++i);}
      if(!fm.fileExists(path))fm.writeString(path,snapshot);return {ok:true};
    }
    if(job.action==='backupUpgrade'){
      const snapshot=JSON.stringify(job.payload?.state||{});if(snapshot.length>200000)return {error:'バックアップ容量を超過しました'};
      const path=fm.joinPath(fm.libraryDirectory(),'nerv_command_v2_state_before_visual_upgrade.json');if(!fm.fileExists(path))fm.writeString(path,snapshot);return {ok:true};
    }
    if(job.action==='backupState'){
      const snapshot=JSON.stringify(job.payload?.state||{});
      if(snapshot.length>200000)return {error:'バックアップ容量を超過しました'};
      fm.writeString(fm.joinPath(fm.libraryDirectory(),'nerv_command_v2_state_before_alert_clear.json'),snapshot);return {ok:true};
    }
    if(job.action==='persist'){
      const s=JSON.stringify(job.payload?.state||{});
      if(s.length>200000)return {error:'保存容量を超過しました'};
      if(stateRecovery?.blocked)return {error:stateRecovery.message};
      const previous=fm.fileExists(statePath)?fm.readString(statePath):null;
      if(previous&&nativeValidState(previous))fm.writeString(lastGoodPath,previous);
      try{fm.writeString(statePath,s);}catch(error){if(previous&&nativeValidState(previous)){try{fm.writeString(statePath,previous);}catch(restoreError){}}throw error;}
      return {ok:true};
    }
    if(job.action==='weather')return await weatherFromCurrentLocation();
    if(job.action==='mapLocation'){
      Location.setAccuracyToHundredMeters();
      const loc=await Location.current();
      if(!Number.isFinite(loc.latitude)||!Number.isFinite(loc.longitude))throw Error('緯度経度を取得できません');
      return {lat:loc.latitude,lng:loc.longitude};
    }
    if(job.action==='battery')return getBatteryInfo();
    return {error:'未対応操作です'};
  }
  const bridge=(async()=>{
    while(shown){
      let jobs=[];
      try {jobs=await web.evaluateJavaScript('setTimeout(function(){ completion(window.__nervQueue ? window.__nervQueue.splice(0,12) : []); }, 400);',true);}
      catch(e){if(shown)console.warn('Bridge paused: '+e);break;}
      if(!Array.isArray(jobs))continue;
      for(const job of jobs){
        // AI requests run outside the queue: saving and controls keep responding.
        if(job.action==='aiReply'){
          aiNativeReply(job.payload).then(async result=>{if(!shown)return;try{await web.evaluateJavaScript('window.__nervDeliver('+JSON.stringify(job.id)+','+JSON.stringify(result).replace(/</g,'\\u003c')+');',false);}catch(e){}});continue;
        }
        let result;
        try{result=await handle(job);}catch(e){result={error:String(e.message||e)};}
        try{await web.evaluateJavaScript('window.__nervDeliver('+JSON.stringify(job.id)+','+JSON.stringify(result).replace(/</g,'\\u003c')+');',false);}
        catch(e){if(shown)console.warn('Deliver failed: '+e);}
      }
    }
  })();
  try {await web.present(true);}finally{shown=false;}
}
Script.complete();
